fact: Guinea's state digitalisation agency ANDE, backed by the World Bank-funded WARDIP programme, held a workshop on 2026-09-23 to validate the feasibility study for a National Digital Academy offering short certified courses, aimed first at civil servants, and the project moves to operationalisation.

fact: The Ministry of Health and Public Hygiene, through the ANSS with IOM Guinea and US CDC funding, launched a training for several health-sector officials in practical use of AI for document analysis, data, alert tracking and decision support in the public health emergency operations centre.

The Ecole Nationale d'Administration, for the Ministry of Modernisation of the Administration and Public Service, ran a 13 to 15 October 2026 training on digital transformation, AI and cybersecurity for 30 national and general directors.
ANSUTEN launched AI Open Days on 28 October 2026 with a session on AI in public administration for 160 officials from four ministries, under the R-CUN programme with Africa Digital Academy.
